CRYPTO.title: [BTC/USD] UP: AI Detects Support at MA20 as Regulatory Catalysts Shift Mildly Bullish
tldr_points: BTC sits 2.1% below its 20-day MA (83010) with RSI neutral (48.5), indicating exhaustion at multi-weekly highs and creating a measured reversion setup toward MA20.
JPMorgan's stance that regulatory moves partially offset the stalled Clarity Act plus the Blockchain Association's tax-clarity push provide a mildly constructive fundamental backdrop.
Operational governance headlines (Coinbase Ireland fine, Fireblocks Visa denial) are noise, not trend catalysts, and currently outweigh the regulatory tailwind.
CRYPTO.excerpt: BTC consolidates below MA20 (83010); RSI neutral at 48.5; expect a measured move toward MA20 on regulatory catalysts.
CRYPTO.comment: Price below MA20 with neutral RSI offers a measured reversion toward MA20; regulatory clarity provides supportive backdrop.
